reactors.context_query: SELECT raw_json FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'FreezerTelemetry' AND "$producer" = ? ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 5

risk_level.instructions: Classify the cold-chain operational risk level for this pharmaceutical vaccine freezer.

criteria.NOMINAL: Temperature at or below -18.0 C with door closed and normal compressor current (~8A)
criteria.LOW: Minor transient fluctuation between -18.0 C and -16.5 C
criteria.MEDIUM: Door open or temperature warming between -16.5 C and -15.0 C
criteria.HIGH: Sustained warming trend approaching -15.0 C with high compressor load (>12A)
criteria.CRITICAL: Temperature above -15.0 C or prolonged door open state under high compressor load (>14A)

estimated_minutes_to_spoilage.instructions: Estimate the remaining time cushion before vaccine spoilage occurs (scaled 0 to 120 minutes).
criteria: 0 minutes remaining: imminent or active thermal spoilage (> -10 C)
15-30 minutes remaining: rapid thermal runaway with open door (-14 C to -11 C)
45-60 minutes remaining: moderate warming trend (-16 C to -14 C)
75-90 minutes remaining: early drift below critical threshold (-17.5 C to -16 C)
120 minutes remaining: stable deep-freeze operation (<= -18 C)

mapping_template.root_cause_prediction: resp.is_thermal_runaway ? 'Thermal runaway due to prolonged door open state under load' : 'Nominal thermal envelope'
